name: linkedin-godmode-plugin
description: Agent-operated generic browser and HTTP primitives for personal LinkedIn workflows using local Chromium/Chrome, Browserbase, or Anchor Browser.

interface.longDescription: Use generic browser, network, JavaScript and HTTP primitives for your authorized LinkedIn workflows. Inspect the current session, capture the relevant request shape, and carry out explicit actions through local Chrome/Chromium, Browserbase or Anchor Browser. Includes five agent skills and a deterministic CLI. Requires Node.js, installed package dependencies, a configured browser provider and your own authenticated session; no hosted browser account or login is bundled.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my LinkedIn session and show which browser provider is connected.
Capture the browser traffic needed to understand the request I am working on.
Use my current session to complete the LinkedIn task I explicitly describe.
